name: Hylda
description: Hylda is one of three witches of Eldraine and the ruler of an ice castle at Loch Larent.

bio.text: She blames Eriette for the curse spiraling, and she granted Ruby a sword of ice with the crown's last magic.

status.text: As of the latest story, Hylda has given up her crown and her castle has begun to melt, after granting Ruby a sword of ice with the crown's last magic.

citations.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 4: Ruby and the Frozen Heart" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Talion asks Kellan to defeat the three witches Agatha, Hylda and Eriette to break the Wicked Slumber in return for a boon.
timeline.quote: Whosoever is brave enough to defeat them shall break the curse upon the Realm

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 1: Pure of Heart
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 1: Pure of Heart" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Peter helps carry the cauldron through a threshold to Talion's court, where Talion names Hylda as the next witch and the mirror Indrelon as the way to find her.
timeline.quote: "But consult the mirror Indrelon, and you may yet find her ."

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 2: Wandering Knight, Budding Hero
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 2: Wandering Knight, Budding Hero" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Troyan tells the mirror something new, and it shows an ice castle at Loch Larent where Hylda lies.
timeline.quote: Beneath the condensation, he sees a castle of ice, faceted and glittering

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 3: Two Great Banquets
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 3: Two Great Banquets" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Hylda's voice warns them to turn back and summons frost warriors, one pinning Kellan's cloak and another seizing Ruby.
timeline.quote: Another warrior's formed, and this one's got her in its clutches.

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 4: Ruby and the Frozen Heart
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 4: Ruby and the Frozen Heart" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Ruby carries Kellan toward the castle over Hylda's taunts, then crawls across the drawbridge past frozen bodies, refusing to abandon him.
timeline.quote: She shifts Kellan onto her back, throws her hands out ahead.

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 4: Ruby and the Frozen Heart
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 4: Ruby and the Frozen Heart" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Hylda appears kneeling beside Ruby and Kellan, extends a hand, clears the weather, and puts them to sleep to keep them safe.
timeline.quote: "Be welcome in Winter's Home."

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 4: Ruby and the Frozen Heart
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 4: Ruby and the Frozen Heart" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: They wake in the ice castle where Hylda hands over her crown as proof of defeat, and the castle begins to melt.
timeline.quote: "Take that to the Kindly Lord, as proof of my defeat."

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 4: Ruby and the Frozen Heart
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 4: Ruby and the Frozen Heart" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Hylda reveals the witches did not create the Slumber alone and that Talion proposed Eriette's sleeping curse for a boon.
timeline.quote: Talion was the one who broke the stalemate.

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 4: Ruby and the Frozen Heart
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 4: Ruby and the Frozen Heart" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Hylda's icy kingdom spreads while she wears the crown, and her heart grows colder.
timeline.quote: With each day she wore the crown, her icy kingdom spread, and her heart grew ever colder.

citation.text: Hylda's Crown of Winter (Wilds of Eldraine Promos, 2023), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Hylda watches Ruby drag Kellan's unconscious body through the cold and feels compassion for the first time in a long while.
timeline.quote: As Hylda watched Ruby drag Kellan's unconscious form through the cold, Hylda felt something she hadn't felt in a long time: compassion.

citation.text: Break the Spell (Wilds of Eldraine, 2023), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Hylda freezes Loch Larent to create her palace; some merfolk escape the chill and others do not.
timeline.quote: When Hylda froze Loch Larent to create her palace, some merfolk dove deep enough underwater to escape the chill.

citation.text: Plunge into Winter (Wilds of Eldraine, 2023), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Kellan's light blades form from empty hilts given by Talion despite Hylda's cold.
timeline.quote: something that poured into the empty hilts he'd been given by Talion and formed thorn-sharp blades of light

citation.text: Kindled Heroism (Wilds of Eldraine, 2023), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Talion and the three witch sisters cast the Wicked Slumber on the plane to halt the invasion; it does not lift.
timeline.quote: had cast the Wicked Slumber on the plane to halt the Invasion

citation.text: "Eldraine", section "The Wicked Slumber". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kellan, with Ruby, kills Agatha and defeats Hylda.
timeline.quote: Kellan, with the help of Ruby , succeeded in killing Agatha and defeating Hylda.

citation.text: "Eldraine", section "The Wicked Slumber". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Fae Lord Talion calls Kellan, aged sixteen, and gives him the quest to defeat the witch sisters and end the Wicked Slumber in exchange for information about his father.
timeline.quote: Kellan was called to realm of the Fae Lord Talion

citation.text: "Kellan", section "The Wicked Slumber". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hylda revives Kellan after the Wicked Slumber, gives up her crown and reveals that Talion was also responsible for the curse.
timeline.quote: informing them that Talion was also responsible for the curse

citation.text: "Kellan", section "The Wicked Slumber". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Eriette and her sisters help Talion cast the Wicked Slumber, receiving the Charmed Apple.
timeline.quote: Talion gave her the Charmed Apple

citation.text: "Eriette", section "The Wicked Slumber". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hylda and her sisters help Talion cast the Wicked Slumber to end the invasion; Talion gives her the Icy Crown.
timeline.quote: Hylda and her sisters Agatha and Eriette helped the faerie Talion cast the Wicked Slumber to end the New Phyrexian Invasion

citation.text: "Hylda", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the invasion Hylda builds Winter's Home, and her ice freezes Loch Larent, trapping the merfolk of Sharae.
timeline.quote: froze over the Loch, trapping the merfolk of Sharae beneath the ice

citation.text: "Hylda", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kellan battles Hylda's ice elementals, discovers his ability to manifest light weapons, and strikes down the last elemental before collapsing.
timeline.quote: he discovered his ability to manifest weapons made from ethereal light

citation.text: "Hylda", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ruby's selflessness convinces Hylda to relent and relinquish her crown, and Hylda kisses Kellan's forehead and protects them from the cold.
timeline.quote: Her act of selflessness convinced Hylda to relent and relinquish her crown.

citation.text: "Hylda", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Talion tasked Imodane with defeating the witch sisters.
timeline.quote: who tasked her with defeating Agatha

citation.text: "Imodane", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ruby carries Kellan to Hylda's portcullis; Hylda relents, revives Kellan, gives Ruby a sword and relinquishes her crown.
timeline.quote: Hylda relented, reviving Kellan, gifting Ruby a sword, relinquishing her crown

citation.text: "Ruby", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Talion and the witch sisters create the Wicked Slumber and Talion gives each an artifact.
timeline.quote: They were forced to join with the witch sisters Agatha , Eriette , and Hylda to create the Wicked Slumber .

citation.text: "Talion", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Talion joins the witch sisters to cast the Wicked Slumber to halt the Invasion, giving each a magical artifact.
timeline.quote: Talion provided each of the witches with a magical artifact that enhanced their powers

citation.text: "Wicked Slumber", section "The Curse". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: Gave her the Icy Crown in exchange for help.
relations.quote: In exchange, Talion gave her the Icy Crown

citation.text: "Hylda", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
